new_statements.quote: 2.1.2. Ударение в Г.я. отсутствует. В тональной системе противопоставляется четыре тоновых уровня (регистра); выделяется четыре уровневых и две контурных тонемы: [...] Две контурные тонемы реализуются как восходящие 1) с ультранизкого до ультравысокого (ǎ) — собственно «восходящий» — и 2) с ультранизкого до высокого (ä) — «средневосходящий». [...] Тононосителем в Г.я. является, судя по всему, не слог, а более крупная единица — стопа («малое» фонологическое слово; см. 2.1.4.), которая может быть как односложной, так и двусложной.
new_statements.translation: 2.1.2. Stress is absent in Gban. In the tonal system four tone levels (registers) are opposed; four level tonemes and two contour tonemes are distinguished: [...] The two contour tonemes are realized as rises 1) from extra-low to extra-high (ǎ), the 'rising' proper, and 2) from extra-low to high (ä), the 'mid-rising'. [...] The tone-bearing unit in Gban is apparently not the syllable but a larger unit, the foot (the 'small' phonological word; see 2.1.4), which may be monosyllabic or disyllabic.
new_statements.citation: Федотов М.Л. 2017. Гбан язык [Gban]. In: Выдрин В.Ф., Мазурова Ю.В., Кибрик А.А., Маркус Е.Б. (eds.), Языки мира: Языки манде. СПб.: Нестор-История, pp. 902-999.

Printed p. 906 (chapter p. 5; volume p. 906), section 2.1.2, reads exactly: '2.1.2. Ударение в Г.я. отсутствует. В т о н а л ь н о й системе противопоставляется четыре тоновых уровня (регистра); выделяется четыре уровневых и две контурных тонемы:' followed by the toneme table (uV kpa̋, V kpá, N kpà, uN kpȁ, rising kpǎ, mid-rising kpä), then…
new_statements.rule_in_words: Gban has no word stress; it is a four-level tone language (extra-high, high, low, extra-low, plus rising and mid-rising contour tonemes) whose tone-bearing unit is the mono- or disyllabic foot; prosodic units are syllable, foot and phonological word, none defined by prominence.
new_statements.secondary_stress: None; no stress of any kind is posited.
new_statements.exceptions: None regarding stress. Intonation is said to be very limited (neutral level contour with downdrift; a 'comma intonation' with final-vowel lengthening; no special interrogative intonation).
new_statements.domain_note: Statement is about the language's phonological system as a whole (word level); the description is based primarily on the Bovo (bɔ̏vɔ̏, Fr. 'touka') variety of Gban (p. 904, 2.0.0).
new_statements.identity_note: Fedotov's chapter describes Gban (gagu1242) as a whole but states (p. 904, 2.0.0) that the description rests primarily on the Bovo (bɔ̏vɔ̏; Fr. touka) north-eastern variety; he notes the southern Gbando variety diverges most. No separate Glottolog dialect codes are known to me for these varieties.

tone_statements.citation: Fedotov, Maksim. 2024. Causative in Gban. Mandenkan 71: 3-38. doi:10.4000/130bd
tone_statements.quote: Gban has four level tones and two contour tones: ultra-high (a̋ ), high (á), low (à), and ultra-low (ȁ); rising (ǎ) and mid-rising (ä). [...] A foot, understood as a prosodic unit larger than syllable and lesser than a phonological word, proved to be relevant for the phonological systems of some tonal languages, notably Mande languages (Kuznetsova 2007; Vydrin 2008). In Gban, the foot is the domain of tone and nasalization.
tone_statements.n_tones: 4 level (eH, H, L, eL) + 2 contour (rising, mid-rising)

tone_statements.citation: Le Saout, Joseph. 2003. Faits de dérivation nominale en gban. Mandenkan 38: 71-87. (Paper read at the 10th West African Languages Congress, Legon, 22-26 March 1972; first published here with an editorial note converting the tone notation to IPA.)
tone_statements.quote: En 1) le verbe prend une hauteur tonal conditionnée, en 2) le verbe apparaît avec sa hauteur tonale intrinsèque qui est aussi celle de l’énoncé injonctif : taÉ marche !, en 3) et 4) il prend les marques aspectuelles de l’accompli. [...] Sur le plan tonal on constate que le lexème verbal dérivé par -E est toujours transposé au ton bas, et ceci quel que soit le degré de complexité de l’ensemble dérivé et quelle que soit la position du lexème verbal par rapport à -E.
tone_statements.translation: In 1) the verb takes a conditioned tone height, in 2) the verb appears with its intrinsic tone height, which is also that of the injunctive utterance: taÉ 'walk!', in 3) and 4) it takes the aspect marks of the perfective. [...] Tonally, the verb lexeme derived by -E is always transposed to low tone, whatever the complexity of the derived whole and whatever the position of the verb lexeme relative to -E.
tone_statements.locator: p. 74 and p. 79; editorial tone note p. 71
tone_statements.n_tones: 4 level (eL, L, H, eH) + 2 rising contours (editorial note restating Le Saout 1…

tone_statements.citation: Houis, Maurice. 1979. [Compte rendu] Le Saout, Joseph, Étude descriptive du gban (Côte d'Ivoire): phonétique et phonologie. Paris, SELAF, 1976, 447 p. (Langues et Civilisations à Tradition Orale, 21). Journal des africanistes 49(2): 174.
tone_statements.quote: L'auteur identifie 6 tonèmes (p. 30). [...] Les unités prosodiques aptes à assumer une fonction distinctive sont exclusivement tonales. Six réalisations tonales différentes peuvent apparaître sur les monèmes monosyllabiques. L'interprétation des unités prosodiques se trouve confirmée par des observations grammaticales. L'examen des sonogrammes agrandis permet de préciser la structure acoustique des réalisations tonales.
tone_statements.translation: The author identifies 6 tonemes (p. 30). [...] The prosodic units able to carry a distinctive function are exclusively tonal. Six different tonal realisations can appear on monosyllabic monemes. The interpretation of the prosodic units is confirmed by grammatical observations. Examination of the enlarged sonograms makes it possible to specify the acoustic structure of the tonal realisations.
tone_statements.n_tones: 6 tonemes (per Le Saout 1976: 4 level + 2 contour in later restatements)

Useful open secondhand statement of the Le Saout inventory while the book itself is search-only/print.
